name: Coffers Finvest Limited
about: Coffers Finvest Limited provides financing, investment, and related financial services as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers equity services enabling clients to buy, sell, and manage equity investments with market guidance, along with access to derivatives, including futures and options trading for hedging and trading strategies. It also operates CreditSea, a personal loan application platform providing lending services to consumers. Coffers Finvest Limited was formerly known as GSB Finance Limited and changed its name to Coffers Finvest Limited in September 2026. Coffers Finvest Limited was founded in 1957 and is based in Raipur, India.
